# maxed-ui

> Lightweight TypeScript + React component kit for accounting and bookkeeping
> screens: a ledger/register table with aligned debit/credit columns and running
> balance, a forgiving money input, a reconciliation diff, status pills, a
> label-aware Select, a stage stepper, a fiscal-period picker, summary cards, a
> progress meter, and a delta badge. Presentation-only; no business logic, no
> network.

Install: `npm install @maxed-oss/maxed-ui` (peer deps: react, react-dom; React 18+).

## Imports

- `@maxed-oss/maxed-ui` : all components, helpers, types, theme tokens.
- `@maxed-oss/maxed-ui/styles.css` : optional theme stylesheet (tokens + dark mode).

## Components

- LedgerTable(entries: LedgerEntry[]) : debit/credit columns, running balance, totals.
- MoneyInput : formatted at rest, forgiving parse (symbols, grouping, parens).
- ReconciliationDiff : books-vs-bank rows flagged match/mismatch/one-sided.
- StatusPill(tone: StatusTone) ; Select/SelectItem (label map auto-derived from children).
- StageStepper(steps: Step[]) ; PeriodPicker (month/quarter/year Period).
- SummaryCard(items: SummaryItem[]) ; ProgressMeter ; DeltaBadge(polarity: DeltaPolarity).

## Helpers

- formatMoney, formatNumber, parseMoney, formatPeriod ("2026-Q2"), formatPeriodLabel ("Q2 2026"), deriveItems, tonePalette, tokens, THEME_ATTR ("data-mx-theme").

## Agent notes

- Typed API; `tsc` verifies generated usage. Dark mode: data-mx-theme attr or prefers-color-scheme.
- Backs no maxed-mcp tool; this is the render layer for the suite's JSON output.
- Test/build: npm test (vitest), npm run build. See AGENT.md for usage facts.
